sentences: Long ago people lived in small villages.
The pyramids in egypt are very old and very tall.
People once wrote on rolled up scrolls.
Old castles had tall stone towers.
Farmers long ago grew grain to make bread.
People traveled on ships with big cloth sails.
The wheel helped people move heavy carts.
Kings and queens lived in grand palaces.
Explorers sailed across the wide ocean to find new lands.
A compass helped sailors find their way.
People made pots and bowls out of clay.
Long ago there were no cars or phones.
Children played with simple toys made of wood.
Museums keep old things so we can learn about the past.
Have you ever seen a dinosaur bone in a museum?
A mammoth was a furry animal much like an elephant.
People used candles and lanterns for light at night.
Long ago builders made roads and bridges of stone.
Markets were busy places where people traded goods.
Weavers made cloth on a wooden loom.
The ancient greeks built beautiful temples.
People in rome built strong roads that still last today.
A fossil can show us what lived long ago.
Can you imagine life before electric lights?
Clever inventors made new tools to help people.
The past is full of wonder and discovery!
History tells us the story of long ago.
Old coins were made of shiny metal.
